messages.text: Here's the short card. The other page is staying home. It took that quite well.
messages.ru: Вот короткая карточка. Второй лист остаётся дома. Он воспринял это спокойно.

intents.label: Похвалить короткую версию
answers: The short one works. I can read it in one look.
This is easy to use. Thanks for cutting it down.

reaction.text: Good. I'll bring just that one.

intents.label: Поддержать шутку про запас
answers: Keep the long one. It can guard the room.
The other page can rest while we work.
